scope: Owner-facing contact status projection for paused, uncertain and stale shadow artifacts. The habitat.read owner view carries a digest-bound algal.host-lifecycle.v1 record per contact plus a separate shadow staleness field; the projection is strictly read-only and cannot reach a send path.
motivation: Wave 3 host-contract adoption: give the owner one honest per-contact status record that reports suspended lanes, unresolved journaled send intents and stale staged artifacts in the shared lifecycle vocabulary, without adding send, retry or mutation authority.

design.projection: contact-status.ts: projectContactStatus reads contact settings, the journaled habitat snapshot and the run journal to build an algal.host-lifecycle.v1 record via buildHostLifecycle. Open send intents or uncertain habitat checkpoints map to uncertain with a retained pendingIntent (the journaled plan digest, else a canonical digest of the journaled intent); paused or disabled lanes map to suspended; the latest terminal run maps to settled or failed; retained work maps to running, else ready.
design.staleness: The shared vocabulary has no stale state, so shadow staleness is reported beside the lifecycle record: shadow.status, shadow.stale, artifact/archive/previous digests, staged and current owner revisions and denied count. activeForReplies stays false; staged artifacts remain inert.
design.authority: permittedOperatorActions lists only what the owner can already do through existing control surfaces: inspect, suspend or resume, reconcile only while a journaled send intent is open, rollback only with a retained shadow artifact or ancestor, stop only while the contact is enabled. The record grants no authority and an uncertain record means reconcile, never retry.
design.surface: control-service adds the projection to the habitat.read view (textbutler habitats show CONTACT). No new command, transport or storage surface; journal and habitat state are only read.
design.dependency: @hraness/algal moves to the frozen host-contract commit 9922202a2da45bb1f7e0db82c0be5a1c6770c21b; contact-status.ts is bundled but out of the reviewed inventory, like the preceding lanes.

independentReview.method: Implementer self-review of the full diff only.

limitations: The status record is a read-only projection: it cannot send, retry, mutate journal or habitat state, or grant authority; reconcile remains the only resolution of an uncertain record.
Stale shadow artifacts stay inert for reply selection; staleness is reported as metadata beside the lifecycle record because the shared vocabulary has no stale state.
This is reviewed source composition with focused synthetic regression evidence, not a live provider qualification, release signature or proof of message delivery.
